svg.text: GHOSTED: The Panel, explore (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Illustrator Phase 1-2: local references, 10 rough thumbnails, 3 directions, one pick. Hand-drawn Bezier half outlines lifted to round bodies (Juno / Ricky sketch code); palette rows only.

DIRECTIONS (3), developed: front and 3/4; then the game camera (x3) with Kit in front (real Juno v1 render cut-out)
A. BOW, FLAT-TOP, BLACK CUBE (pick)
Three shapes at a glance: a round head with a
cream bow (Culture Fit), a square flat-top and
glasses with a marker (Whiteboard), a plain black
cube with a cream 'camera off' icon. The light
panel-edge table (row 24) makes the black cube
the strongest value in the set, so the joke reads.
Lilac cardigan vs navy vest + light-blue shirt:
no locked-cast row as a big area.
B. BMGD LITERAL: SPHERE HEADS
The hint as given: two bare sphere heads and a
box on a wood table. At the game camera the two
heads are the same ball: they read apart by
colour only, which the brief rules out. The box
melts into the wood table in grey (2.2:1).
C. CLOUD, SPIKES, MONITOR, WOOD
Big cloud hair, spiky tech hair, a black monitor
on a wood table. The monitor reads as a real
screen (a laptop prop, not a person). The cloud
hair spreads beside the face (temple rule risk)
and the spikes break the toy-pawn calm.
